title: v2 Stage 7a: kill DD threshold sweep (8% -> {4, 6, 10, 12}%)
baseline: Stage 5b: top_k=10, kill_threshold=8%, cooldown=20d, on_cross_section kill check
method: For each threshold in {4, 6, 10, 12}%, run per-bull-leg backtest (10 legs). Compare mean closed_only, mean MDD, meeting_target_count.
expected_outcome: Lower threshold (4-6%) → more aggressive kill, MDD ↓, closed ↓. Higher threshold (10-12%) → less aggressive kill, MDD ↑, closed ↑.
target: identify threshold that meets all 3 targets (ann>=12%, sharpe>=1.2, MDD<=12%) on more legs
